_notes: Best-effort fact sheet of the 34 product types the old engine made on 16 October 2026, exported on 17 October from the old event store (read-only, via the research trace loader) before the fresh start.
'old_engine' is the retired score and decision, kept only for comparison; the R19 points come from the facts.

Facebook 'linked_ads' are the ads that created or were matched to the type; ads saved by later cross-check searches were never reviewed by the old engine (their questions show 'interpretation_pending'), so they are counted only in 'website_questions', not listed.

Amazon/Flipkart 'related_listings' come from the old AI relevance reviews (relationship other than 'unrelated'); only 6 types had such a review; at most 20 are listed per type ('related_listings_total' gives the full count). 'origin.listing_details' holds at most 10 of the type's own source listings (store listings carry their roles, such as best-seller lists, and created_at).
Google Trends 'saved_charts' exist for 6 types; for the rest Trends was not read.
Supplier 'assessments' are the 8 AI reviews of company pages; phone numbers and e-mails were masked.
Gaps: the 'definition' outcome (accepted / too vague / format failure) is not a stored field; read it from 'ai_jobs' (role B/E outcomes and failure codes).
